title: [Question] How to persist Filters
body:
Hello folks,

Using an instantsearch application I detected as recurrent user that is a little tidious setup filter every time that I enter at the website. I want to improve the UX!

![](https://d3uepj124s5rcx.cloudfront.net/items/0K0m2f220j3R1f3p333s/Screen%20Recording%202017-02-21%20at%2006.00%20pm.gif?v=1fdf5346)

A simple strategy for that could be, every time that any filter is modified, serialized the value and store it at `localStorage`.

Then, the nex time that the user enter at the main endpoint of the website (this means, with no query params) retrieve the last filters value for localStorage.

Do you think that could be more or less easy to implement?
Do you think that have sense support this feature inside or out of the instantsearch core?

Any opinion is welcome 😄
